title: 茶水间英文 - 10月10日 | 沙特机场遇袭、AI劫银行案、板球票疯抢
description:
Alex and Jordan break down the weekend's biggest headlines: Houthi missile strikes that shut down flights at Riyadh's airport, an AI hacking tool used to rob nine South Korean banks before its maker pulled it offline, and more than a million cricket World Cup ticket applications in just 48 hours. Each story comes with a ready-to-steal small talk line, plus a playful random question: what would you do with one hour of invisibility?

今天 Alex 和 Jordan 聊了三个大新闻：胡塞武装导弹袭击沙特利雅得机场、多家航空公司停飞；一款 AI 黑客工具被用来攻击韩国九家银行，开发者吓得紧急下架；2027 板球世界杯门票开售仅 48 小时就收到超一百万份申请。每个话题都附一句拿来即用的英文开场白，最后还有一道快问快答：如果你能隐形一小时，你会做什么？

Words to steal 生词本:
- ballistic missile — 弹道导弹
- falling debris — 坠落的碎片；残骸
- stealable line — 拿来即用的开场白；可以直接借用的表达
- penetration testing — 渗透测试（主动测试系统安全性）
- pull the plug — 终止；叫停（项目）
- closed source — 闭源；不再公开源代码
- first come, first served — 先到先得
